info.title: Spendly API
info.description:
Personal finance API for the Spendly mobile app.

**Auth:** call `POST /api/v1/auth/login`, then send `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` on every other request. Click **Authorize** above to do that here.

**Errors:** every error is `application/problem+json` (see the `ApiProblem` schema). Switch on the `code` field.

**Money** is a decimal string (`"1250.50"`), never a number. **Times** are ISO-8601 UTC instants (`2026-11-26T08:15:00Z`).

Trade the refresh token for a new access token **and a new refresh token**. Replace both in storage. The old refresh token stops working.

Run **one refresh at a time**: if two requests use the same refresh token, both fail and the device is logged out (this is how a stolen token is detected).

401.description: `INVALID_REFRESH_TOKEN`: unknown, expired, revoked or reused. Clear tokens and show login.

post.description: Revokes this refresh token's session. Needs no access token, so it works even after the access token expired. Always 204, even for an unknown token, so it is safe to retry.
Revokes every refresh token of the logged-in user, on all devices. Access tokens already issued keep working until they expire (at most `expiresIn` seconds).

accountIds.description: Ids in the new order, first = top of the list.

ApiProblem.description: RFC 9457 Problem Details. Switch on `code`, never on `title` or `detail`.

detail.description: Human-readable, safe to show the user.

requestId.description: Same id as the X-Request-Id response header; quote it in bug reports.

errors.description: Only for VALIDATION_FAILED: one entry per invalid field.

ValidationError.description: Only for VALIDATION_FAILED: one entry per invalid field.

currentBalance.description: Negative on a credit card means money owed.

availableCredit.description: Credit cards with a limit: limit + balance.

amountOwed.description: Credit cards: how much is owed (0.00 if nothing). null for other types.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. null until chosen in onboarding.

timezone.description: IANA timezone. 'Today' and 'this month' are computed in this zone.

onboardingCompleted.description: false = show the onboarding screens after login.

password.description: 8 to 72 characters and at most 72 bytes (emoji count as 4).

refreshToken.description: The refreshToken from the last login or refresh.

expiresIn.description: Seconds until the access token expires.

refreshToken.description: Keep in secure storage. Trade it at /auth/refresh. **Single use**: each refresh returns a new one; using an old one again logs this device out.

refreshTokenExpiresAt.description: When the refresh token expires if not used.

email.description: Case-insensitive; spaces around it are ignored.

deviceLabel.description: Optional name of this device, shown later in the device list.

newPassword.description: 8 to 72 characters and at most 72 bytes (emoji count as 4).

deviceLabel.description: Label for the new session on this device.

type.description: Cannot be changed later. CREDIT_CARD is a liability.

icon.description: Phosphor icon name. Default depends on type.

openingBalance.description: Default 0. For a credit card, send the amount owed as a NEGATIVE number (-5000.00).

includeInTotal.description: Count this account in net worth. Default true.

statementDay.description: Credit cards only. Day of month the statement is generated.

dueDay.description: Credit cards only. Day of month the bill is due.

UpdateProfileRequest.description: Send only the fields you want to change. Missing or null fields are left unchanged.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code. Changes formatting only; amounts are never converted.

timezone.description: IANA timezone. Decides what 'today' and 'this month' mean.

UpdateAccountRequest.description: Send only the fields you want to change.

openingBalance.description: Changing it moves the current balance by the same difference.

totalLiabilities.description: Total owed on credit cards, as a positive number.

currency.description: The user's currency, for formatting. null before onboarding.

bearerAuth.description: Access token from /api/v1/auth/login. Expires after `expiresIn` seconds.
